# Viruchith Ganesan — Portfolio & Technical Profile

> Backend Engineer specializing in Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, and Cloud-Native Systems on Kubernetes and GCP.

## Summary
Viruchith Ganesan is a backend engineer based in Bengaluru, India with 3+ years of experience engineering high-throughput microservices and modernizing legacy enterprise systems at Lumen Technologies. Experienced in full lifecycle migrations (Restlet/WildFly/JBoss to Spring Boot microservices on Kubernetes/Rancher on GCP), distributed event-driven architectures with RabbitMQ, relational database performance tuning (PostgreSQL, Oracle), and production observability (Splunk, AppDynamics, Datadog).

- **Current Role**: Software Development Consultant I at Lumen Technologies (Oct 2025 – Present)
- **Previous Role**: Software Development Engineer at Lumen Technologies (Jul 2023 – Oct 2025)
- **Education**: B.E. Computer Science and Engineering, Sona College of Technology (2019–2023, GPA 8.85/10)
- **Key Certifications**:
  - Google Cloud Certified Associate Cloud Engineer (GCP ACE, Feb 2024)
  - Google Cloud Certified Generative AI Leader (Oct 2026)

## Core Technical Skills
- **Languages**: Java (Core, Concurrency, Multithreading, OOP, DSA), Python, TypeScript, SQL
- **Frameworks**: Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data, Hibernate, JPA, JUnit, Mockito
- **Cloud & Orchestration**: Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Kubernetes, Rancher, Docker, Linux Administration
- **Messaging & Data**: RabbitMQ, PostgreSQL, Oracle, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, Apache Solr, Palantir Data Hub
- **Observability**: Splunk, AppDynamics, Datadog, JVM Heap/Thread Dump Analysis
- **Legacy Modernization**: Restlet to Spring Boot migration, Tomcat, WildFly, JBoss, JEE, JSF, Mainframe decommissioning
